part.text:
Fixed in `tokio/src/sync/broadcast.rs:814`: `recv_ref` now detects a closed channel when the receiver has caught up to the tail, returning `Closed` instead of registering a waiter that will never wake. This fixes both the hanging `recv` and erroneous `Empty` from `try_recv` after resubscribing.

Validation: `cargo test -p tokio --test sync_broadcast` passes all 25 tests, including `resubscribe_to_closed_channel`.
